observed_structure: Each SIMDgroup owns one logical GDN input-projection row, with eight row owners sharing a threadgroup.
SIMDgroup lanes walk packed char4 columns with a literal stride of 32.
Runtime input_rows bounds output rows, hidden_size determines the packed column count, and input_groups_per_row selects the FP32 scale-row stride, with 16 char4 values per scale.
Each lane converts one char4 weight vector to FP32, takes its dot product with the corresponding float4 input, and applies the row-local group scale.
An FP32 register accumulates the scaled vector dot products before simd_sum reduces them across the SIMDgroup.
Lane zero publishes the reduced row value directly into the device GDN projection buffer.
variant_notes: The row count, hidden width, and scale-row stride come from GdnParams rather than file-level model constants.
An out-of-range input-projection row returns the entire SIMDgroup before the lane-strided dot product.
The cited span writes every valid row into one device projection buffer; downstream interpretation remains with the enclosing multi-kernel occurrence.
